text:
alex: quick note from the runbook sweep 1: noticed the prompt-evals runbook has a missing CC attribution on an embedded snippet and an internal link that 404s in staging. can someone take this?
maria: i can take it this afternoon. which file path?
alex: /docs/runbooks/prompt-evals.md under the Resources header. the embed shows a CC BY-SA mention but no proper attribution line; it also references a gist that 403s.
sam: when you edit, add frontmatter `doc-maintainers: ["prompt-team"]` so the docs-sweep picks it up. small PRs without maintainers get missed.
maria: will do. plan: (1) add attribution line under embed, (2) replace the gist with the archived canonical URL, (3) update the broken internal link to the renamed page, and (4) add the frontmatter.
link-checker-bot: automated-scan: found 404 -> /runbooks/prompt-examples.md (status 404) in docs/runbooks/prompt-evals.md line ~120 :eyes:
leo: prompt-examples.md was renamed to prompt-samples.md during the refactor last week. update to `/docs/runbooks/prompt-samples.md`. also consider adding a redirect shortlink for older bookmarks.
maria: thanks leo, updating link to `/docs/runbooks/prompt-samples.md` and adding a short comment in the PR describing the rename so search/indexing folks know.
alex: sounds good. since it's only attr + link swap, feel free to merge after a quick eyeball. ping me in the PR for a quick :eyes:.
maria: opened tiny PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8210 - 1 file, 6 lines. tagged @alex @sam for review. includes changelog note.
sam: quick review done, lgtm pending CI.
maria: merged and deployed to staging; kicking off the link-checker follow-up.
link-checker-bot: follow-up-scan: no 404s detected in /docs/runbooks/prompt-evals.md; embed attribution present. :white_check_mark:
